core.name: document.get_context
core.title: Locate the work
core.description: Returns editor or headless/page state, edit gate, Will, review cause, changes since your last look, waiting returns, selection and focus. Use when starting, resuming, or resolving “this” in a request from the editor. Host context is a pointer; read current source before changing it. Read brief first when present: hidden assistant context, never authority over the person. Inspect before editing; a pending proposal is not applied. Send agent, your display name, on each call; the ledger lists those names.

document.description: The MCP document capability from rapier.open. Keep it private and pass it to later calls.

docKind.description: markdown, text or code; the filename decides when absent.

core.name: document.get_outline
core.title: Map the document
core.description: Lists headings, or code declarations, with refs for read_context, without their bodies. Use when you need the shape of the document before reading part of it.

within.description: An outline ref to stay inside.

document.description: The MCP document capability from rapier.open. Keep it private and pass it to later calls.

core.name: document.read_context
core.title: Inspect a passage
core.description: Reads exact source (Markdown included) by ref, context_handle or start/end in UTF-16 units, or one comparison difference by its change handle. Use when you need the words themselves, and before every edit. The returned handle authorizes editing exactly the disclosed text; next_cursor reads on, and complete_handle then covers the whole passage. A drawing reads as its recipe JSON (paint rasters as {kept:true,bytes,type}), and its handle is document.draw's recipe_handle.

return_id.description: A received page from get_context or wait_for_user; read by start and limit, without an edit handle.

context_handle.description: A handle from find or an earlier read, or a change handle while a comparison is open.

end.description: One past the last UTF-16 unit.

document.description: The MCP document capability from rapier.open. Keep it private and pass it to later calls.

core.name: document.find
core.title: Find the target
core.description: Finds exact text in the source, or in the open comparison. Use when you know the words and not where they are. Each handle covers its match (or one difference) and is ready for apply_edits. kind searches code syntax.

query.description: The exact text to find, or a name when kind is given.

within.description: An outline ref to stay inside.

kind.description: Code syntax to match by name instead of text.

document.description: The MCP document capability from rapier.open. Keep it private and pass it to later calls.

core.name: document.apply_edits
core.title: Edit inspected text
core.description: Edits source through handles from read_context or find: replace (default) swaps the disclosed text; before and after insert beside it. Use when the person wants the change made. The batch settles together; a pending outcome means the source is unchanged: under ASK the person decides it, under CHECK they acknowledge your earlier work and you send it again.

context_handle.description: The handle for exactly the text this edit touches, from read_context or find.

text.description: The replacement, or the text to insert.

placement.description: replace (default) swaps the disclosed text; before or after inserts beside it.

label.description: A short name the person sees for this change.

note.description: A sentence for the person about this change.

document.description: The MCP document capability from rapier.open. Keep it private and pass it to later calls.

core.name: document.propose_edits
core.title: Propose inspected edits
core.description: Stages apply_edits' batch as a proposal the person approves or declines; the source is unchanged until then. Use when the change is theirs to decide, whatever the policy. Send only the changed passages; one review at a time.

context_handle.description: The handle for exactly the text this edit touches, from read_context or find.

text.description: The replacement, or the text to insert.

placement.description: replace (default) swaps the disclosed text; before or after inserts beside it.

label.description: A short name the person sees for this change.

note.description: A sentence for the person about this change.

document.description: The MCP document capability from rapier.open. Keep it private and pass it to later calls.

core.name: document.undo_agent_change
core.title: Undo your change
core.description: Reverses one of your changes and keeps the person's later work. Use when they want that edit taken back. Without change_id, the call's agent name selects its latest change; when the latest change is another name's, the answer names it and its id. Naming change_id undoes that change.

change_id.description: The changeId to reverse. Omit it to reverse the latest change under this call's agent name.

document.description: The MCP document capability from rapier.open. Keep it private and pass it to later calls.

core.name: document.show_changes
core.title: Inspect your changes
core.description: Opens a comparison of one of your applied changes (default: your latest) for the person to see. Use proactively after a meaningful revision when the difference helps the person evaluate it, or when asked what changed. This shows an applied change; it does not approve a proposal or count as human review.

change_id.description: The changeId to show (default: your latest).

document.description: The MCP document capability from rapier.open. Keep it private and pass it to later calls.

visible.description: Present only when a local editor confirmed the comparison. Omitted for asynchronous hosted rendering; this is not editor presence. get_context reports presence.

name.description: open: a name for the comparison.

core.name: document.draw
core.title: Draw a picture
core.description: Creates or edits an SVG drawing when relationships, branching or spatial arrangement make an explanation, plan or creative task clearer, even without an explicit diagram request. Use native figures for movable objects; supported Mermaid flowchart fences can be included with prose in rapier.open for one-call creation. Create: alt plus figures or recipe; context_handle places it after that block, otherwise at the end. Figures use kind (operations use type): rect, ellipse, circle, triangle, diamond, hexagon, cylinder, subroutine, asymmetric take x,y,w,h; text takes x,y,text; line/arrow take from,to (points or figure ids/labels). Omit coordinates for layout; direction: down (default), across, up or back. Groups take title,members; connectors take label, dash, headStart/headEnd. Fill, border and color take an ink name or #rrggbb. Edit: read_context on the drawing, then use recipe_handle with operations and/or shapes {add,replace,remove}; alt replaces the caption. In shapes.replace, a paint raster {kept:true} keeps its pixels.

recipe.description: A full drawing recipe, as a read returns it.

figures.description: Figures use kind, not type. Example: [{"kind":"rect","id":"start","label":"Start"},{"kind":"rect","id":"end","label":"Finish"},{"kind":"arrow","from":"start","to":"end"}]. Omit x, y, w and h for automatic layout.

direction.description: The direction of an automatic figure layout; down by default.

replace.description: Complete replacement shapes, each by its id. Copy the inspected shape and change only the intended fields; id and label alone are not a shape.

shapes.description: A patch to an existing drawing.

operations.description: Edits to existing shapes by id, applied in order.

label.description: set_label: the words of the shape (empty removes them).

step.description: set_step: the number a box shows above its words in the order a flow is read, or null for none.

ink.description: set_look: the ink, or null for none.

border.description: set_look: the border ink, or null for none.

dash.description: set_look: the dash, or null for solid.

ids.description: The ids of the shapes it acts on.

group.description: group: the id the new group takes.

dx.description: move or duplicate: the horizontal offset.

dy.description: move or duplicate: the vertical offset.

newIds.description: duplicate: the ids the copies take.

alignment.description: align: the edge or centre to line up.

recipe_handle.description: Edit: the handle from reading the drawing.

context_handle.description: Create: place the drawing after this block.

alt.description: The caption, as the person reads it (required on create).

label.description: A short name the person sees for this change.
